# Parity: every user-visible capability of 4.7.28 in version 5

Source: ROADMAP.md 1.0.0 Part C (2026-11-17). 43 capabilities: **14 kept**, **9 replaced**, **19 dropped** (moved out of the product or stopped), **1 undecided**. 11 rows are product-scope decisions for the owner to confirm (marked "owner").

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
